label: Service Design Blueprint
description: Map the end-to-end service experience across all channels and touchpoints. Align front-stage interactions with back-stage processes, systems, and support structures.

modelTier.notes: Sonnet for most service blueprinting. Opus for complex multi-channel services with many stakeholders.

guidedInputs.label: Service Description
guidedInputs.description: What service is being blueprinted? Who delivers it? Who uses it?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Onboarding for a new small business banking customer — from initial inquiry to first transaction.

guidedInputs.label: Scenario / User Journey
guidedInputs.description: What specific scenario or user journey should the blueprint cover?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. A freelancer applies for a business account online, uploads documents, waits for verification, and receives the account.

guidedInputs.label: Service Channels / Touchpoints
guidedInputs.description: Which channels are involved in this service?

options.label: Identify pain points and failure points
